mentions.h: 18 th. ANNUAL 20 MILES OPEN ROAD RACE

photos.c: January 3rd 1970 at Milford Heath and no. 80, Bob Holt (Hercules Wimbledon), leads the Surrey Senior Cross Country Championships from no. 13, Gerry North (Belgrave). Bob eventually won with Gerry runner up and Dave Holt, pictured behind Bob, 3rd. Also to be seen are Chris Wade of Ranelagh (brother of tennis star Virginia), no. 11 Adrian Major (Belgrave) who placed 5th, no. 77, Mick Fuller (Hercules Wimbledon) and we can just spot Bob Gevers (SLH). Hercules Wimbledon won the team race from Mitcham with the Bels. 3rd.
